Pushed to `main` (c3b42a9): `results/paired_comparisons.csv`, `results/bias_check.csv`, re-run `results/bound_check.csv`, corrected `results/robustness.csv` (grouped_org rows), notes in `code/RESULTS.md`, `code/README.md`, `DERIVATIONS.md`. Numbers not mentioned below were read against the CSV/code and are **confirmed**.
  > 
  > ## 1. Protocol (`protocol.tex`)
  > Confirmed: fixed design (30 % T, 5 partitions per fold, S from the other 70 %), grouped 10-fold, time-forward cuts 55/70/85 %, fit-then-select-then-predict on training rows, closure on mean squared standardised error, standardised-RMSE definition, k* censoring (grid_max+1), grid (1-10, 12, 15, 20, 30, capped at N/2; HELM tops out at 20 via the N/2 cap on the candidate pool).
  > Corrections:
  > - **LOBO reference.** It is the lower-error of the factor-model and Ledoit-Wolf conditional predictors, chosen on held-out error per dataset and split (`lobo_source`), and LW is that lower one in every dataset and split (`refs.csv`). Wording: "the LOBO reference is the better, on held-out error, of the factor-model and Ledoit-Wolf leave-one-benchmark-out predictors (Ledoit-Wolf in every dataset and split)". It is a reference, not an achievable method; the in-sample reference (factor model fitted with the test rows' targets) is *not* an optimistic bound everywhere (MTEB-Eng grouped: in-sample 0.479 > LOBO 0.470), so do not call it a bound; call it "a reference in which the factor model has seen the test row's targets".
  > - **Family rule.** Organisation + first two name tokens applies to MTEB. On HELM MMLU the family is the first word of the model name, which is the organisation (21 families), so on HELM the grouped and organisation-grouped splits coincide.
  > - **Transform choice.** "picked per pool on the training folds" overstates. The logit mask and clipping are per fold on training rows, but identity versus logit is chosen once per pool by the majority of outer-fold inner-CV held-out likelihoods (with Jacobian), so it used every model of the pool. Wording: "the transform family (identity or logit) is chosen once per pool by the majority over outer folds of the inner-CV held-out likelihood; both are reported (Table A-robust)". The effect is small (both are reported) but it is not training-rows-only. MTEB-Multi is chosen logit by likelihood, but identity has the lower held-out RMSE there (`transform.csv`, choice_by_error = identity).
  > - **Rank.** Table 1 `r_eff` = 4 / 10 / 2 is the pool-level choice (`datasets.csv`); the ranks the main runs used per outer fold have medians 4 / 6 / 2 (MTEB-Multi folds 3-8; `info[...]['r_eff']` in the raw pickles). Say "selected rank (pool fit) 4, 10, 2; median over folds 4, 6, 2" or use fold medians.
  > 
  > ## 2. Sections 6.2-6.4
  > Confirmed: closure 0.81 / 0.82 / 0.96; RMSE 0.62 / 0.59 / 0.53 and LOBO values; Table 2; gaps -0.038 / -0.076 / -0.044 with CIs and 6.1 / 11.3 / 7.6 %; per-k % of random error (MTEB-Eng k=3 CI includes 0; HELM k=20 gap slightly positive); "40-70 % of the oracle's gap"; k* 9 (CI 3-31) and 30 (8-31, = grid max), censored shares 3 % / 26 %; time-forward gaps -0.041 / -0.086.
  > Corrections:
  > - **Column mean 1.04, 1.03, 1.16**: confirmed for the reference used in closure (`refs.csv`, arithmetic training mean). The column-mean predictor of `curves.csv` and Table A5 (per-benchmark skill) back-transforms the logit-space mean on MTEB-Multi/HELM (RMSE 1.052 / 1.168), a slightly weaker baseline; add to the Table A5 note: "baseline = back-transformed logit-space column mean on MTEB-Multi and HELM MMLU (about 2 % higher RMSE than the arithmetic mean)".
  > - **Factor-model k\* on MTEB-Multi** ("15" under identity vs headline 30): not like for like; the headline is the better of FA and best-simple under the chosen (logit) transform; FA alone under logit is censored beyond 30, under identity it is 15. Say which when quoting.
